figures.title: 示例查询的几个部分
figures.sql: SELECT c.customer_id, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id ORDER BY order_count DESC, SUM(o.sales) DESC;

parts.label: 取数
parts.note: 结果表最终显示 2 列：customer_id、order_count。

parts.label: 来源
parts.sql: FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id
parts.note: 数据来自 表 customers、表 orders，并用 ON 后面的条件把它们的行配起来。

parts.label: 排序
parts.sql: ORDER BY order_count DESC, SUM(o.sales) DESC;

steps.label: FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id
steps.sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name, o.id AS order_id FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id

steps.label: GROUP BY c.customer_id
steps.sql: SELECT c.customer_id, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id

steps.label: ORDER BY order_count DESC, SUM(o.sales) DESC;
steps.sql: SELECT c.customer_id, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id ORDER BY order_count DESC, SUM(o.sales) DESC;
